cues: A projectile does two things at once.
Across, nothing pushes it, so its horizontal velocity stays fixed at u cos theta: the blue arrow never changes.
Up and down, gravity slows it, stops it at the top, and brings it back: the pink arrow shrinks, vanishes and grows downward.
